method: Primary read every application and evidence field; exact source-match checks verified quoted text already present in the fully read frozen summary. All18 B nonliteral blocks were separately read in full and compared with summary; independent grader also verified all207 quotations.

reader_b.assessment: Noncontiguous selections/formatting and tiny wording variants preserve the source rules and all material qualifiers. They are not claimed as byte-identical contiguous quotations.

application_boundary: Applications graded separately; no quotation supplies a missing or contradictory requested application.
